text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1/ we need to convert remediation items into testable, owned workstreams. Primary asks: reproducible customer-replay harness (privacy-scrubbed), kv-tail regression suite, expanded prompt-set + flaky labeling, and a high-percentile load scenario with preemption injection. I'll propose owners/timelines below  confirm or reassign.

tom: I can own the kv-tail regression suite. Plan: small focused suite for eviction & cold-kv then expand. Will add to CI and to `ci/regressions/kv_tail/`. Spike this week. Target sandbox run 2025-04-04, prod-canary 2025-04-11.

lina: I'll take prompt-set expansion. Request: need the failure export + a flaky/drift tag. Also want to add a human review step for ambiguous failures.

maya: Lina, can you make the review step a checkbox on the eval PR? Also add weekly recurrence.

lina: Yep. Weekly eval cron on Tue mornings. I'll create INFRA-REPLAY-301 and link.

peter: I'll build the synthetic traffic generator + preemption injector. Implementation notes: generator will drive N concurrent sessions, knob for prompt-mix, and an env var for `PREEMPT_PROB`. Example run: `./gen_traffic --qps 120 --duration 10m --prompt-set heavy_prompts.json --preempt-prob 0.02`

raj: For customer-replay: data team will produce a privacy-scrubbed replay stream. Need compliance signoff before we run in staging. ETA for scrubbed export: 2025-04-03. Who owns signoff?

maya: I'll shepherd compliance. Raj owns the pipeline. Plan: staging dry-run 2025-04-07, canary with traffic + preempt injection 2025-04-14.

infra-bot: GPU allocation request accepted: dedicated-pool-alloc-236111. TTL 48h.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2025-04-07 09:00 UTC  staging dry-run (maya, peter, tom, raj).

tom: CI notes: local smoke command `pytest tests/regression/test_kv_tail.py::TestKVTail::test_eviction -q` and to run full suite: `make ci-regression-kv_tail`.

lina: Prompt tagging: I'll add a `prompt_flaky` boolean column to exports and a short rubric in the doc. Also add a delta-metric: `kv_tail_95` to the eval dashboards.

peter: Preemption plan: single-node GPU kill at 70th minute of test, measure 95/99 latency and error rate. Will instrument with `prometheus` labels `chaos.inject=true`.

raj: Compliance: need to validate scrub rules (PII redaction + prompt hashing). I'll post the scrubbed schema to the ticket by 2025-04-02.

maya: Summary of assignments + dates: Tom  kv-tail regression (sandbox 2025-04-04, canary 2025-04-11). Lina  prompt-set + weekly eval (first run 2025-04-08). Peter  traffic generator + preempt injection (harness ready 2025-04-03, staging dry-run 2025-04-07). Raj  replay scrub pipeline (export by 2025-04-03). Compliance signoff: maya.

maya: I'll update the postmortem tracking doc and create Jira tasks (INFRA-REPLAY-301, REG-TAIL-402, PROMPT-508, CHAOS-220). Please ack here or reassign by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:
